pages.text: Summoning spirits or creatures out of nothings it beyond your abilities.$(br2)It is however possible to keep a spawner active, even without anyone being near it, if an active Summon Ritual is within range.
Must be placed within a 9x9x9 cube around a spawner.

pages.title: Ritual Specifics
pages.text: $(bold)Duration:$() The ritual lasts $(ritual:summon_creatures/SECONDS/duration) seconds, with the entity being summoned after $(ritual:summon_creatures/SECONDS/interval).
